mapper.sql: s.shift_id shiftId,s.live_date liveDate,s.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName,s.anchor_user_id anchorUserId,u.nick_name anchorName,s.start_time startTime,s.end_time endTime,s.remind_at remindAt,s.status,s.ding_user_id dingUserId,s.remark
mapper.select: select ,x.submission_id submissionId,x.submitted_at submittedAt, x.exposure_delta exposureDelta,x.watch_delta watchDelta,x.interaction_delta interactionDelta, x.new_fan_delta newFanDelta,x.deal_delta dealDelta from live_metric_shift s join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id left join live_metric_submission x on x.submission_id=( select max(latest.submission_id) from live_metric_submission latest where latest.shift_id=s.shift_id and latest.status='CONFIRMED' and latest.is_effective=1 ) and s.live_date>=#{beginDate}and s.live_date<=#{endDate}and s.room_id=#{roomId} order by s.start_time limit 500
select from live_metric_shift s join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where s.shift_id=#{shiftId}
select count(*) from live_metric_shift where room_id=#{roomId} and status<>'CANCELLED' and start_time<#{endTime} and end_time>#{startTime}and shift_id<>#{shiftId}
select count(*) from live_metric_shift where anchor_user_id=#{anchorUserId} and status<>'CANCELLED' and start_time<#{endTime} and end_time>#{startTime}and shift_id<>#{shiftId}
select count(*) from live_metric_shift where anchor_user_id=#{anchorUserId} and live_date=#{liveDate} and status<>'CANCELLED'and shift_id<>#{shiftId}
select count(*) from live_metric_submission where shift_id=#{shiftId}
mapper.delete: delete from live_metric_shift where shift_id=#{shiftId} and not exists(select 1 from live_metric_submission where shift_id=#{shiftId})
mapper.select: select r.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName,(select group_concat(m.user_id order by u.nick_name) from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' where m.subject_type='ROOM' and m.subject_id=r.room_id and m.role_code='anchor') anchorIds from live_room r where r.status='0' order by r.room_name

select r.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName,(select group_concat(m.user_id order by u.nick_name) from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' where m.subject_type='ROOM' and m.subject_id=r.room_id and m.role_code='anchor') anchorIds from live_room r where r.status='0' and exists(select 1 from live_subject_user_map mine where mine.subject_type='ROOM' and mine.subject_id=r.room_id and mine.role_code='anchor' and mine.user_id=#{userId}) order by r.room_name

select u.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,b.ding_user_id dingUserId from sys_user u left join live_ding_user_bind b on b.user_id=u.user_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.nick_name
select hidden_user_id from live_metric_user_hidden_staff where viewer_user_id=#{viewerUserId}
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select count(*) from live_subject_user_map where subject_type='ROOM' and subject_id=#{roomId} and user_id=#{userId} and role_code='anchor'
select ding_user_id from live_ding_user_bind where user_id=#{userId} order by last_sync_time desc limit 1

select template_id templateId,room_id roomId,template_name templateName,start_clock startClock,end_clock endClock from live_metric_shift_template where room_id=#{roomId} order by sort_order,template_id
select count(*) from live_metric_shift_template where room_id=#{roomId} and template_name=#{templateName}and template_id<>#{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into live_metric_shift_template(room_id,template_name,start_clock,end_clock,sort_order,create_by,create_time) values(#{roomId},#{templateName},#{startClock},#{endClock},coalesce((select max(x.sort_order)+1 from live_metric_shift_template x where x.room_id=#{roomId}),0),#{createBy},now())
mapper.select: select r.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName from live_metric_room_alias a join live_room r on r.room_id=a.room_id and r.status='0' where a.alias_key=#{aliasKey} limit 1

select session_id sessionId,room_id roomId,reported_room_name reportedRoomName,room_name_key roomNameKey,live_start_time liveStartTime,match_status matchStatus from live_metric_live_session where room_name_key=#{roomNameKey} and live_start_time=#{liveStartTime} limit 1 for update

select session_id sessionId,room_id roomId,reported_room_name reportedRoomName,room_name_key roomNameKey,live_start_time liveStartTime,match_status matchStatus from live_metric_live_session where room_id=#{roomId} and live_start_time=#{liveStartTime} limit 1 for update

select session_id sessionId,room_id roomId,reported_room_name reportedRoomName,room_name_key roomNameKey,live_start_time liveStartTime,match_status matchStatus from live_metric_live_session where session_id=#{sessionId}

select , case when s.start_time<=#{snapshotAt} and s.end_time>=#{snapshotAt} then 1 else 0 end currentShift, case when exists(select 1 from live_metric_submission existing where existing.session_id=#{sessionId} and existing.shift_id=s.shift_id and existing.status='CONFIRMED') then 1 else 0 end hasSubmission from live_metric_shift s join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where s.room_id=#{roomId} and s.status<>'CANCELLED' and s.end_time>#{liveStartTime} and s.start_time<=#{snapshotAt} and s.end_time>=date_sub(#{snapshotAt},interval 12 hour) order by currentShift desc,hasSubmission asc,abs(timestampdiff(second,s.end_time,#{snapshotAt})),s.end_time desc limit 20

select submission_id submissionId,session_id sessionId,shift_id shiftId,match_status matchStatus,exposure_delta exposureDelta,watch_delta watchDelta,interaction_delta interactionDelta,new_fan_delta newFanDelta,deal_delta dealDelta from live_metric_submission where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select submission_id submissionId,session_id sessionId,shift_id shiftId,match_status matchStatus,remark from live_metric_submission where submission_id=#{submissionId}
select count(*) from live_metric_submission where session_id=#{sessionId}

select x.submission_id submissionId,x.session_id sessionId,x.shift_id shiftId,x.exposure_total exposureTotal,x.watch_total watchTotal,x.deal_total dealTotal,x.new_fan_total newFanTotal,x.interaction_total interactionTotal,x.snapshot_at snapshotAt,x.submitted_at submittedAt,x.value_source valueSource,s.start_time startTime,s.end_time endTime,s.anchor_user_id anchorUserId,u.nick_name anchorName,s.ding_user_id dingUserId,r.room_name roomName from live_metric_submission x join live_metric_shift s on s.shift_id=x.shift_id join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where x.session_id=#{sessionId} and x.status='CONFIRMED' and x.shift_id is not null order by s.start_time,x.snapshot_at,x.submission_id

select submission_id submissionId,session_id sessionId,shift_id shiftId,snapshot_at snapshotAt from live_metric_submission where session_id=#{sessionId} and status='CONFIRMED' order by snapshot_at,submission_id

select from live_metric_live_session ls join live_metric_shift s on s.room_id=ls.room_id join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where ls.session_id=#{sessionId} and s.status<>'CANCELLED' and s.end_time>ls.live_start_time and s.start_time<=coalesce((select max(snapshot_at) from live_metric_submission where session_id=#{sessionId}),now()) order by s.start_time
mapper.update: update live_metric_shift s set s.status='PENDING',s.update_time=now() where s.status='SUBMITTED' and exists(select 1 from live_metric_submission x where x.session_id=#{sessionId} and x.shift_id=s.shift_id)
update live_metric_shift set status='SUBMITTED',update_time=now() where shift_id=#{shiftId}

update live_metric_shift s set s.status=case when exists(select 1 from live_metric_submission x where x.shift_id=s.shift_id and x.status='CONFIRMED' and x.is_effective=1) then 'SUBMITTED' else 'PENDING' end,s.update_time=now() where s.shift_id=#{shiftId}
mapper.select: select x.submission_id submissionId,x.session_id sessionId,x.shift_id shiftId,ls.room_id roomId,coalesce(r.room_name,ls.reported_room_name) roomName,ls.reported_room_name reportedRoomName,ls.live_start_time liveStartTime,ls.match_status roomMatchStatus,x.match_status matchStatus,x.is_effective isEffective,x.value_source valueSource,x.snapshot_at snapshotAt,x.submitted_at submittedAt,x.exposure_total exposureTotal,x.watch_total watchTotal,x.interaction_total interactionTotal,x.new_fan_total newFanTotal,x.deal_total dealTotal,x.exposure_delta exposureDelta,x.watch_delta watchDelta,x.interaction_delta interactionDelta,x.new_fan_delta newFanDelta,x.deal_delta dealDelta,s.anchor_user_id anchorUserId,u.nick_name anchorName,s.start_time startTime,s.end_time endTime,s.ding_user_id dingUserId,x.remark,(select l.send_status from live_metric_reminder_log l where l.shift_id=x.shift_id and l.reminder_type='SUBMITTED' order by l.sent_at desc limit 1) dingNotifyStatus,(select l.error_message from live_metric_reminder_log l where l.shift_id=x.shift_id and l.reminder_type='SUBMITTED' order by l.sent_at desc limit 1) dingNotifyError from live_metric_submission x join live_metric_live_session ls on ls.session_id=x.session_id left join live_room r on r.room_id=ls.room_id left join live_metric_shift s on s.shift_id=x.shift_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id and ls.live_start_time>=concat(#{beginDate},' 00:00:00')and ls.live_start_time<date_add(#{endDate},interval 1 day)and x.match_status=#{matchStatus}and ls.room_id=#{roomId} order by x.submitted_at desc,x.submission_id desc limit 500

select from live_metric_shift s join live_room r on r.room_id=s.room_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where s.status='PENDING' and s.remind_at<=now() and s.ding_user_id is not null and s.ding_user_id!='' and not exists(select 1 from live_metric_submission x where x.shift_id=s.shift_id and x.is_effective=1) and not exists(select 1 from live_metric_reminder_log l where l.shift_id=s.shift_id and l.reminder_type='FIRST' and l.send_status='SENT') limit 50
mapper.insert: insert into live_metric_reminder_log(shift_id,reminder_type,ding_user_id,send_status,error_message,sent_at) values(#{shiftId},#{reminderType},#{dingUserId},#{sendStatus},#{errorMessage},now()) on duplicate key update send_status=values(send_status),error_message=values(error_message),sent_at=now()
